summary: The proof is correct and complete. The proper-cap and full-cap support-contact cases both yield the required one-sided section limits; the infimum-crossing sequence validly forces each limiting section length to be at least D; the convex perpendicular-segment lemma holds in all intersection and nonintersection cases, including endpoint contact; and the resulting bound m >= M contradicts the strict residual-domain inequality m/M < rho < 1.
